fruit-slice.hint: Swipe through the fruit as it flies up. Slice several in one swipe for a bonus.

fruit-splash.hint: Tap the fruit to splat it on the wall. Make a mess, then save the picture.

tower-topple.hint: Tap to drop each crate on the tower. Stack as high as you can, then knock it down.

coconut-bowling.hint: Swipe up from the coconut to roll it at the pear pins. Five frames, two rolls each.

juice-press.hint: Press and hold to squeeze the fruit, let go to splash the juice. Fill three glasses.

fruit-merge.hint: Swipe to slide the fruit. Two of a kind merge into a bigger fruit.
fruit-merge.won: Watermelon! Keep going for a high score.

fruit-sort.hint: Tap a jar, then tap another to pour. Sort so every jar holds one fruit.

catch-the-fruit.hint: Move the basket to catch falling fruit. Skip the worms.

fruit-memory.hint: Flip two cards at a time and find all the pairs.

fruit-maze.menuDesc: Guide the boy through the orchard, collect every fruit and keep clear of the turtle, the fox and the monkey.
fruit-maze.noStorage: This browser is not saving data, so progress will reset when you leave.
fruit-maze.kbd: Arrows or WASD to move · Esc to pause
fruit-maze.restartNote: Restarting this level puts your score back to {s} and your lives back to {l}, as they were when the level began.
fruit-maze.tut1: Use the arrows, WASD or the on-screen buttons to walk. You stop when you let go.
fruit-maze.tut2: Walk over fruit to collect it: apple 10, banana 15, orange 20, strawberry 25.
fruit-maze.tut3: Animals cost a life if they touch you. You restart at the gate and stay safe for 2 seconds.
fruit-maze.tut4: Collect all the fruit on the map to finish the level.
fruit-maze.completeSub: You finished every level with {l} lives to spare.
fruit-maze.overSub: The animals win this round. Have another go!
fruit-maze.retryNote: Try again starts level {n} with 3 lives and a fresh score.

fruit-puzzle.hint: Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it. Put the picture back together.

fruit-flip.hint: Tap a tile to flip it and its neighbours. Turn every lemon into a green apple.

fruit-beats.noAudio: Sound is not available in this browser.

fruit-garden.hint: Pick a seed, tap a bed to plant, tap again to water. Your garden keeps growing while you are away.
fruit-garden.planted: {e} planted. Tap the bed to water it.
fruit-garden.harvested: {e} harvested! Three went into your basket.
fruit-garden.watered: Watered. It will grow a little now.
fruit-garden.basketEmpty: Your basket is empty for now.
fruit-garden.noPressure: Plants never wilt. There are no reminders or notifications.

fruit-pond.hint: Touch the water to make ripples. Watch the fruit drift.
fruit-pond.stat: Touch or drag across the water

orchard-sounds.noAudio: Sound is not available in this browser.

tea-time.hint: Brew a cup step by step: tea, fruit, water, then wait.

sunset-peel.hint: Trace the spiral slowly from the green dot to peel the orange in one long strip.

fruit-mosaic.hint: Pick a fruit tile and tap or drag on the grid to make a picture.

smoothie-studio.hint: Add fruit, blend, pour a layer. Stack up to five layers and add toppings.
smoothie-studio.full: The blender is full. Blend and pour first.
smoothie-studio.addFirst: Add some fruit to the blender first.
smoothie-studio.glassFull: The glass is full. Add toppings or start a new glass.

pattern-maker.stat: Edit the small tile; the pattern repeats it

kaleido-draw.hint: Draw anywhere in the circle; your line is mirrored all around.

sticker-scene.hint: Tap stickers to add them, drag to move. Use the buttons to resize and rotate.

citrus-stamps.hint: Pick a fruit stamp and an ink, then tap the paper to print.
